en: You can drive in the rain too?

zh-Hans: 现在只能忍住，先跟紧他。
en: For now, I just have to be patient and stay with him.
I'll pass you, no matter what!

zh-Hans: 我竟然会在雨天下坡被逼成这样……
en: To think I'd be pushed this hard on a wet downhill...

zh-Hans: 骗人吧，刚才发生了什么？！
跟不上！每过一个弯，差距就实实在在地拉开一点！
en: I can't keep up! Every corner, he pulls a little farther away!

zh-Hans: 太快了！那种速度，我根本理解不了！
en: He's too fast! I can't even comprehend that speed!

zh-Hans: 我没法用同样的速度冲进弯。我和他，到底差在哪里？！
en: I can't enter the corners at his speed. What's so different between us?!
No good! I can't keep up!

zh-Hans: 来得好！过上三个弯，就让你从后视镜里消失！
en: Fine by me! Three corners, and you'll be gone from my mirror!
I'm not letting you catch me!

zh-Hans: 我要把领先优势越拉越大！

en: I can't keep towing him along forever!
All right! Let's see how long you can stay with me!

zh-Hans: 离终点不远了，能甩掉他！
en: Not far to the finish now. I can hold him off!

zh-Hans: 我可不客气了！你不会再出现在我的后视镜里！
en: No more holding back! You won't show up in my mirror again!

zh-Hans: 我不过是稍微认真了一点。
en: I just got a little serious, that's all.

zh-Hans: 跑开了！今天我的状态绝佳！
en: I'm in the groove! I'm on top form today!
Unbelievable. Is that all you've got?

zh-Hans: 只要一下雨，我的 Q's 连涡轮车都能甩掉！
en: When it rains, my Q's can leave even turbo cars behind!
